# The Hyp Engine

> AI-native media agency that produces media, content, and paid campaigns - plus websites, brand identity, and creative - for growth-stage businesses built around revenue, not vanity metrics.

The Hyp Engine is an AI-native media agency for D2C, SaaS, app, and B2B brands. Primary focus: media production (AI-generated video and content), content, and paid media. One team also handles the website, the brand, and organic/CRO work that drives and converts traffic - instead of clients juggling separate freelancers and agencies. AI is used to produce faster and generate content at scale; the strategy and judgment stay human.

## Services

- [Media Production](https://www.thehypengine.com/media-production/) - AI-native video production, AI-generated video and stills, ads, social cuts, case study content, product video, brand video, no shoot days or crews, turnaround in days not weeks
- [Content](https://www.thehypengine.com/media-production/) - AI-generated content at scale, content built for the platform it's going on, content calendars tied to strategy not just posting volume
- [Paid Media](https://www.thehypengine.com/paid-media/) - Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, paid social, paid search, performance marketing, daily campaign optimization, ROAS and CPA management, full-funnel attribution
- [SEO](https://www.thehypengine.com/seo/) - organic search growth, technical SEO audits, keyword strategy tied to buyer intent, on-page optimization, link building, content built for search visibility
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.thehypengine.com/web-dev/) - websites built to convert, UX/UI design, frontend and backend development, landing pages, conversion-focused web design
- [Creative & Branding](https://www.thehypengine.com/creative/) - brand identity, visual identity systems, brand strategy, narrative design, logo and identity design, content systems
- [Social Media](https://www.thehypengine.com/social/) - social media management, content strategy, community management, platform-native content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X
- [CRO & Automation](https://www.thehypengine.com/cro/) - conversion rate optimization, funnel audits, marketing automation, A/B testing, landing page optimization

## Key facts

- Positioning: AI-native media agency - AI used for production and scale, human strategy and creative direction throughout.
- Engagement model: month to month, no lock-in contracts.
- Clients can start with a single service (e.g. just media production or paid media) and expand later.
- Clients own their ad accounts, website code, creative files, and domain at all times.
- Entry point: a free marketing audit, available via the site's "Start The Audit" flow.
- Founder: Mebin Zachariah, 7+ years industry experience.
- Contact: contact@thehypengine.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thehypengine
